profile_text.body:
Saul is associated with the website counsel.com, which belongs to WealthCounsel, a provider of legal document software, trust and estate planning tools, and continuing legal education resources for attorneys. WealthCounsel's offerings include document drafting platforms such as Wealth Docx, Elder Docx, Business Docx, Wealth Tracx, and Gun Docx, organized under membership tiers including Elite and Trusts and Estates Professional. The site also describes practice management integration with LEAP, an Advisors Forum membership for financial advisors, and a range of marketing and education resources aimed at estate planning and business law practitioners.

The held facts associate the name Saul with a product called SaulLM, described as a French legal-domain large language model with specialized training and EU data governance considerations. There is a notable mismatch between that product description and the WealthCounsel website content, which contains no reference to SaulLM or any AI language model. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
